about_short_description.short_description: Prometheus is an oil and gas company.

product.name: Carbon-Neutral Synthetic Liquid Fuels
product.description: Synthetic methanol, diesel, jet fuel, gasoline, and related hydrocarbons produced from atmospheric CO₂ and renewable electricity using direct air capture and electrochemical conversion.

identifier.value: Ultra Long Duration Energy Storage (ULDES) Systems

product.name: Ultra Long Duration Energy Storage (ULDES) Systems
product.description: Energy storage systems that convert surplus renewable electricity into liquid fuels for storage over months and later use in generators to provide dispatchable power.

product.name: Fuel Forge Systems
product.description: Containerized fuel-production systems that synthesize liquid fuels locally from air and electricity, including in remote, temporary, or off-grid operating environments.

identifier.value: Direct Air Capture and Hydrocarbon Electrolysis Technology

product.name: Direct Air Capture and Hydrocarbon Electrolysis Technology
product.description: An integrated process that captures atmospheric CO₂ into water as carbonate ions and converts it directly into alcohols and hydrocarbons using electrochemical reactors.
